svg.title: Medium pedal — internal layout, top down
svg.desc: Draft 2D layout of the 1590DD-size pedal: 99 x 59 screen cutout at the top-left, Pi landscape behind it, three footswitches, input and output jacks on the top edge, codec at the right, output board and Pico in the front strip.
svg.text: MEDIUM PEDAL — INTERNAL LAYOUT, TOP DOWN
178.26 × 110.26 mm internal · draft, not a drilling template · positions from your corrections
Lid removed / see-through: the screen cutout is in the lid, the Pi hangs below it.

g.text: Keep parts and wires clear of them.
left, 9 from top. No module outline
is dimensioned; the cutout is exact.
The 9 mm strip above it is free for the
Pi’s USB-C/HDMI leads; the Pi top edge
sits 1.5 mm below the cutout top.
Holes 58 × 49. The Pi is clear of
IN / OUT both on the top edge:
OUT x=120, IN x=158, ~38 mm apart.
Codec sits between them, FS3, the
Pi and the right wall; input lead
clear of the input side. A second
21 mm tall; moved up by the pillar
width to clear it. XH sockets on top.
≈ 30 of 33; Pi clear of FS2 in plan.
SECTION A–A (through x = 89: Pi, FS2, Pico and bottom-centre pillar)
screen 7 + standoff 6 + Pi 17 ≈ 30 of 33; Pi clear of FS2; pillar full height.
Drawing units are mm; print 300 mm wide for 1:1 (not to scale on screen).
